OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her wearing the game cosplay chosen in SCENE — a daring adult cosplay of the video game character named there, as worn to a cosplay event, an arcade night or a photo shoot. In this cut the outfit itself shows that game character: its recognisable colours, shapes and parts. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

SCENE (chosen):
Place: a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars
Weather / season: a rainy day — rain falls outside and streaks any window; surfaces are wet where she is outdoors.
Time of day: night — the scene lit by lamps, screens or windows, dark outside.
Outfit: a daring adult cosplay of Zeri from League of Legends — the costume's recognisable colours and parts, cut as a high-cut bodysuit with sheer thigh-high stockings
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand rests on her hip.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand tucks hair behind her ear.
LEGS: weight on one leg, the other knee softly bent.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: a slight smile, lips closed. Keep it subtle and natural, a light touch rather than acting: no sneer, glare, smirk-pulled cheek or chin lifted to look down at the viewer; her face stays relaxed and attractive. Her eyes are naturally open and clear, not heavy-lidded or half-closed; brows relaxed and even, neither raised on one side nor furrowed; lips softly closed or only just parted.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: moderate — some exposed arms or lower legs, with intimate areas covered

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely into the cosplay SCENE describes. The costume must read at first glance as that game character's look, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit in the cut SCENE names; she is a real woman in a cosplay, not the character — never the character's face, body or creature shape, no logo or readable text, and no weapon or prop weapon in her hands.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera exactly as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same. No default card pose, no default front-facing portrait.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

FIGURE: tall and statuesque with long legs and a full, curvaceous figure — full bust and hips, narrow waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

AVOID: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
